        cin >> a[i];
    }
    int T;
    cin >> T;
    sort(a, a + n);
    int left = 1, right = n, result = 1;
    while (left <= right) {
        int mid = (left + right) / 2;
        bool found = false;

                found = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (found) {
            result = mid;
            left = mid + 1;
        } else {
            right = mid - 1;
        }
    }
    cout << result << endl;
    return 0;
}
